title: NewsTopics
description: NEWS-00. The fixed set of News topics (spec/news/topics.json): the channels a person can follow and the labels the embed role classifies each item against. `description` is the text the embed role compares an item's title and summary with. `bands` says which age bands are offered the topic: `kids` is offered to the child band only; the rest to teens and adults. Politics is deliberately not a topic (it folds into `world` and `local`).

icon.description: A lucide icon name (the kit icon registry).

section_style.description: NEWS-SECTION-STYLES-01. How the topic's section page arranges its stories, as Apple News does per category: top_stories (tall cards, then picture-right cards), special (two large cards, then picture-right cards), todays_news (tall cards, then one wide split card). Absent draws the lead-and-list page. Arrangement only: selection, order and age gates are unchanged.
